# Use an AI agent and check what it says

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_pathways.py from data/pathways.yml. Do not edit this file: change the data and run the script. -->

Start an agent in a MESA app and test its answers against the data.

**6 tutorials, 40 to 45 minutes in all.** Take them in order, or start wherever your question is. Nothing is locked.

New to the portal? Take [New to MESA](new-to-mesa.md) first.

!!! warning "These tutorials are drafts"
    Each tutorial says at the top how far it has been checked.

## Run and understand

*Understand data.* You can say what a dataset holds and where it is incomplete or doubtful, before you compute with it.

1. [Practice data: five invented rain gauges](../tutorials/practice-data.md) (5 minutes)
2. [Load a file from your Data Store into a notebook](../tutorials/load-a-file.md) (5 minutes)
3. [Tally a quality flag before you trust a number](../tutorials/tally-a-quality-flag.md) (5 minutes)

## Query and connect

You can ask questions across files and tables, and show that combining them did what you meant.

1. [Keep tokens and passwords out of saved files](../tutorials/keep-secrets-out-of-files.md) (5 to 10 minutes)

## Explore and verify

*Explore with AI and verify.* You can work with an AI assistant and test what it tells you against the data.

1. [Sign in and start an AI agent in a MESA app](../tutorials/start-an-ai-agent.md) (10 minutes)
2. [Check an AI-suggested result against the data](../tutorials/check-a-suggested-result.md) (10 minutes)
